reviews.title: Best Push/Press up App
reviews.text:
Loved this app from the start. The ability to have a lifetime purchase alone is outstanding. The amount of widgets here is something other app developers need to pay attention to. The program is awesome. The difficulty does ramp up quick though, so what I’ve done in the past is just reset and build up from a slightly higher level each time I can’t finish a workout “unbroken”. This reset also gives your tendons a chance to catch up, as they don’t recover as fast as muscles do. Great for building your chest and triceps, while strengthening your core without the need for weights. Connects with your apple fitness app where some others do not. Their plank challenge app is good also. 
Ps. Don’t forget to increase your protein intake. You can track this for free using the app “Cronometer” (which also connects to apple health).
